title: Vendune — Open-source agentic commerce with merchant control
description: Explore an open-source Rust ecommerce prototype with merchant-approved AI actions, local LLMs, MCP/UCP adapters and selected Shopware behavior ports.

title: Real Rust commerce benchmarks: catalog, cart and durable checkout
description: Inspect reproducible local HTTP and PostgreSQL benchmarks, before-and-after results, raw latencies, hardware, validation and explicit measurement limits.

title: Run a Rust ecommerce prototype locally | Vendune
description: Start the storefront and merchant workspace with Rust, PostgreSQL and Docker. No model download required for the initial commerce tour.

title: Connect Claude Desktop to a commerce MCP server | Vendune
description: Configure a local Model Context Protocol bridge to Vendune. Learn which tools are public and how merchant approval and workspace authority work.

title: Port Shopware pricing behavior to Rust with differential tests
description: How Vendune checks bounded pricing, context and shipping-tax ports against original Shopware PHP classes, with explicit compatibility limits.

title: Try a connected commerce playground | Vendune
description: Create a separate local shop and try product variants, customer addresses, a coupon, graphical order flows, delays and PDF invoices without a model provider.
